subtasks: Arrange the five nesting dolls in a row from left to right, from smallest to largest.
Place the second-largest upright yellow doll from the far left upright in the fourth position of the size-sorted row, to the right of the middle doll. Keep the smaller dolls in place.

Use the right gripper to place the largest upright yellow doll from the near right at the far-right end of the row. Align its base front-to-back with the other upright dolls and leave a clear gap to its left neighbor. Withdraw the left arm clear of the row.

Stand the fallen middle-sized doll upright in the gap between the second and fourth dolls. Pinch across its body with one jaw in front and one behind, lift clear, rotate its head up and its flat base down, then lower it onto the row and release. Keep the other dolls in place.
